Blue | 2x Founding Engineers + EA | Remote | Full-time | https://joinblueai.com/join-us

1x Backend/Infra Engineer + 1x Mobile/iOS Engineer + 1x SuperAdmin/EA

Now that we're closing a new big round, we're hiring. Small elite team or bust. Existing team includes: post-exit robotics founder + PhD AI/robotics + cracked fullstack webdev.

If you know anyone awesome, see our referral bounty at bottom. I'm all ears!

Blue is a complete operating system for your personal health and longevity. Integrate all your health data & records into one place. Share access with any doctor. When a doctor logs in, it morphs into a fullstack next-gen EHR. You, and only you, own and control all your data. We envision a WAY better healthcare system.

More details: https://joinblueai.com/join-us

Apply via email to roles@joinblueai.com (include resume/CV, LinkedIn/GitHub + quick blurb on 1–2 systems you’ve owned end-to-end that are most similar to Blue in some way) and mention this HN post.

Bounty: $500 for each referral that makes it to our final interview. If we hire them and they make it past 6mo, $5000 + dinner for the 3 of us @ a Michelin-starred restaurant + free lifetime access to Blue.
